item.title: Food Line Briefing — June 11, 2026
item.description: Catholic Community Services' Tucson food bank saw rising demand from first-time visitors. Supplies were running out more regularly, and some visitors could not get food because lines were too long or supplies were nearly gone in Tucson, AZ. Catholic Community Services' food bank has seen rising demand from first-time visitors and to their clothing donation center. Many of the people who are now coming in haven't consistently used community food resources in the past. Vanessa Rodriquez said she's begun utilizing food banks for the very first time in her life as her grocery bills have gotten too.

item.title: Food Line Briefing — June 10, 2026
item.description: WSLS reported rising food-assistance demand in Roanoke, VA, affecting children, SNAP households, low-income households. ROANOKE, Va. Roanoke City's St. Francis House Food Pantry faced completely empty shelves in May. Now in June, the pantry is facing an even tighter situation heading into summer, and the people who run it say the situation is only getting harder.

item.title: Food Line Briefing — June 8, 2026
item.description: NEPM reported rising food-assistance demand in Western Massachusetts, including strain affecting SNAP households. another aspect of that Big Beautiful Bill is shifting the cost of SNAP onto states, if they can't keep their error rate below 6%. Massachusetts is hovering around 14%. And an under-resourced DTA is more likely to make mistakes. When benefits are delayed or paused, food pantries may see higher demand from households that rely on SNAP.
